events.verdict: Barnes (SAS) brings his right hand to Garland's (CLE) front and the contact that occurs as Garland passes at the end of the drive is marginal.
Johnson (SAS) cleanly dislodges the ball away from Allen (CLE) and simultaneous marginal contact from Paul (SAS) occurs with Allen's left arm as Allen is already off-balance in the lane.
Strus (CLE) uses his left hand to cleanly dislodge the ball from Castle (SAS) in transition.
Vassell (SAS) is established in Mitchell's (CLE) path and absorbs the marginal body contact as Mitchell spins back toward him.
Johnson (SAS) engages and disengages with Allen (CLE) as they each attempt to establish rebounding position.
Allen (CLE) extends his left arm up for the rebound and makes incidental contact with Vassell's (SAS) right arm.
Johnson (SAS) establishes a screening position in Hunter's (CLE) path and absorbs the contact as it occurs.
Mitchell (CLE) grasps and then quickly releases Barnes' (SAS) left arm during the rebound.
Paul (SAS) engages and disengages with Allen (CLE) after the release of the jump shot attempt.
Allen (CLE) brushes Castle's (SAS) right arm and marginal contact occurs as Castle mishandles the ball on his own during the rebound.
Hunter (CLE) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it away from Paul (SAS).
Hunter (CLE) and Strus (CLE) pursue the loose ball and the ensuing contact with Paul (SAS) is incidental.
Barnes' (SAS) right arm becomes tangled with Garland's (CLE) left arm and the contact that occurs during Garland's drive is marginal.
Hunter (CLE) legally contests Castle's (SAS) jump shot attempt.
Johnson (SAS) commits a take foul on Allen (CLE).
Allen (CLE) legally contests Johnson's (SAS) dunk attempt.
